title: Lisa Barlow Reveals New Song “Echoes of You,” Follow-Up to First Single “Baby Gorgeous”: “I’m in My Pop Star Era, and I Love It” (Exclusive)
summary: ‘The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City’ star tells THR she’s dropping her next single in September, and teases what’s to come from season seven of the Bravo hit: “It's one of our best seasons ever.”
